NVIDIA’s work with Amkor and SPIL expands advanced packaging capacity for current and next-generation accelerated computing platforms. NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 and Vera CPUs began volume shipments in the third quarter, leveraging TSMC’s 5nm, 3nm and CoWoS advanced packaging technologies. Foxconn is deepening its collaboration with NVIDIA, drawing on its global production network to support next-generation GPU and networking platforms.
